title: The Knowledge Building WordPress plugin before 0.7.3 does not escape several user-supplied values before echoing them…
description: The Knowledge Building WordPress plugin versions before 0.7.3 contain a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This occurs because several user-supplied values are not properly escaped before being echoed back in the response of an AJAX action accessible to unauthenticated users. The response is served as HTML, enabling potential injection of malicious scripts.
